records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our revenue from direct and indirect sales to customers in Asia was 85% and 88% of our total revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2023 and 2022, respectively, and 84% and 89% of our total revenue for the six months ended June 30, 2023 and 2022, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The semiconductor industry has been facing a number of macro-economic challenges including reduced consumer spending on nonessential goods, fluctuations in demand for semiconductors, rising inflation, increased interest rates, and fluctuations in currency rates.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The $3.5 million increase in cost of revenue was primarily driven by product mix and higher manufacturing overhead costs, which were partially offset by lower shipment volume and lower inventory write-downs and warranty expenses.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: To date, we do not believe we have experienced any material information security breaches and have not incurred significant operating expenses related to information security breaches.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2023, the $96.7 million increase in cash provided by operating activities compared to the prior period was primarily due to increased accounts receivable collections.
